steps.name: reapply-gate1-role-binding
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch -q origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/payloads/20260905-growbox-gate1-role-binding-v2/apply.sh > /tmp/growbox-gate1-role-binding-v2.sh; bash /tmp/growbox-gate1-role-binding-v2.sh

verify_steps.name: focused-semantic-binding-tests
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-gate1-role-binding -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug >/tmp/gate1-role-binding-cmake.log; cmake --build build/host-gate1-role-binding --target climate_semantic_output_tests --parallel 1; ./build/host-gate1-role-binding/climate_semantic_output_tests; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

verify_steps.name: full-quality-gate-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED_PARENT=3f413a2bb517f90637cf9b7849ea2fd1e09e5e5b; BRANCH=mvp/environment-controller; NEW=$(git rev-parse HEAD); test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "$EXPECTED_PARENT"; export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1; bash scripts/quality_gate_push.sh; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch -q origin "$BRANCH"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$EXPECTED_PARENT"; git push origin HEAD:"$BRANCH"; git fetch -q origin "$BRANCH"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$NEW"; printf 'GATE1_ROLE_BINDING_COMPLETE commit=%s parent=%s fan_endpoint=1 lamp_endpoint=2 humidifier_endpoint=3 outputs=fake-locked rf_tx=0\n' "$NEW" "$EXPECTED_PARENT"
